name: Displays Arranger
author: faperac
description: Arrange your monitors from the Omarchy bar, macOS-style: drag screens to lay them out (they stay edge-to-edge, no dead gaps), set resolution, refresh, scale and rotation, then Apply — it writes ~/.config/hypr/monitors.lua and reloads Hyprland, with a 12-second auto-revert if something goes wrong.

barWidget.description: Drag-to-arrange monitor layout, resolution, refresh, scale and rotation
